headline: Mammorest mining mount
title: Mammorest | Giant Mount For Logging and Mining | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a mount that farms for you in Palworld one point zero? Mammorest is a huge Grass and Ground Pal. It works Planting level four, Lumbering level four and Mining level four. Its partner skill, Gaia Crusher, lets you ride it and boosts logging efficiency by two hundred twenty to five hundred percent, and mining efficiency by five hundred to two thousand percent. Will you ride Mammorest? Comment below!
description: Mammorest in Palworld 1.0 is a giant rideable Grass and Ground Pal that boosts logging and mining.
